package.description: A self-healing, resilient Secure Access client for Windows.

en-US.description: A self-healing, resilient Secure Access client for Windows.
en-US.longDescription: The Resilient Secure Access Client provides resilient Zero Trust connections to private applications, cloud services, and websites for hybrid, mobile, and field workers. It is designed to maintain connectivity and provide a self-healing client experience.
en-US.name: Resilient Secure Access Client
